stage_a.command: uv run --frozen python benchmarks/longmemeval_bench.py DATA/longmemeval_s_cleaned.json --out RUNS/stageA-mempalace-raw.jsonl

rusty_brain.command: cargo run --release -p rb-eval --features record-local --bin external-bench -- longmemeval --data DATA/longmemeval_s_cleaned.json --profile PROFILE --out RUNS
